# Dependencies

<!-- Generated by /ai-context. Manual edits are overwritten on re-run. -->

## AS IS — Current state

### External services

| Service | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| MySQL 8 | Sole datastore in dev/prod: 12 catalog tables, `training_sessions`, `users`/`passkeys`, plus framework `sessions`/`cache`/`jobs`. Wired by `config/database.php` + `.env` `DB_*`; `docker-compose.yml` runs `mysql:8.0` with volume `sail-mysql`. |
| SQLite (in-memory) | Test datastore only — `phpunit.xml` forces `DB_CONNECTION=sqlite`, `DB_DATABASE=:memory:`, so the suite never touches the dev database. |
| SMTP / mail transport | Only consumer is Fortify email verification. `.env.example` ships `MAIL_MAILER=log`; `phpunit.xml` uses `array`. `config/mail.php` also carries the framework's SES/Postmark/Resend stanzas, none of which the app code calls. |
| WebAuthn authenticator (platform/roaming key) | Passkey login and enrollment through `Features::passkeys(['confirmPassword' => true])`; browser side is `@laravel/passkeys`. Discovery document at `/.well-known/passkey-endpoints`. |
| Docker (optional) | `docker-compose.yml` — Sail track for public clones; the default environment is host-native PHP/Composer/npm (`.ai/guidelines/php-laravel.md`, `README.md` "Trilha 2"). No standalone `Dockerfile`; the image comes from `vendor/laravel/sail/runtimes/8.4`. |
| GitHub Actions | `.github/workflows/tests.yml` — the only CI: PHP 8.4 + Node 22, `composer setup`, `php artisan migrate:fresh --seed --force`, then `composer ci:check` with `coverage: none`. `dependabot.yml` handles updates. |

No third-party HTTP API, no object storage, no payment/analytics/telemetry SDK, no feature-flag service is referenced anywhere in `app/`, `routes/` or `config/`. `AWS_*` and `REDIS_*` variables exist in `.env.example` because the stock `config/filesystems.php` and `config/database.php` declare those stanzas; no code path reaches them, and `README.md` lists Redis as out of v1.

### Internal libraries

No private Composer or npm packages are installed. First-party code is organized as two framework-free TypeScript modules inside the repo, consumed by the Vue layer:

| Module | Role |
| --- | --- |
| `resources/js/canvas/` (14 modules + 8 `.test.ts`) | Diagram engine: `engine`, `nodes`, `edges`, `geometry`, `layout`, `view`, `undo`, `order`, `legend`, `links`, `labels`, `catalog`, `icons`, `limits`, `svg`, `types`, `fixtures`. Imports no Vue/Inertia and touches no `document`/`window` — swept by `tests/Feature/Frontend/CanvasEngineTest.php`. |
| `resources/js/prancheta/` (13 modules + 11 `.test.ts`) | Board logic: `session` (store + dirty signature), `autosave`, `resume`, `clock`, `roteiro`, `estimate`, `problems`, `sessions`, `notes`, `legend`, `theme`, `tabs`, `export`, `warnings`, `fixtures`. |
| `resources/js/lib/` | Thin adapters: `sessionTransport.ts` (the only module that knows the `/api/sessions*` wire format), `downloadFile.ts` (the quarantined DOM step of SVG export), `flashToast.ts`, `utils.ts`. |
| `resources/js/{actions,routes,wayfinder}/` | Wayfinder build artifacts — generated at build time, gitignored, ESLint-ignored. Not hand-edited. |
| `app/Concerns/` | Shared PHP traits: `ReadOnlyAtRuntime`, `HasActiveScope`, `PasswordValidationRules`, `ProfileValidationRules`. |

Optional platform binaries (`package.json` optionalDependencies): `@rollup/rollup-{linux-x64-gnu,win32-x64-msvc}` `4.9.5`, `@tailwindcss/oxide-{linux-x64-gnu,win32-x64-msvc}` `^4.0.1`, `lightningcss-{linux-x64-gnu,win32-x64-msvc}` `^1.29.1`, `@laravel/multiplex` `^0.4.1`.

Version drift is not silent: `tests/Feature/StackContractTest.php` asserts the declared constraint of every frontend and backend dependency, so bumping a package without updating that test fails the suite. `.ai/rules/general.md` records that Inertia 3 is final — downgrading to 2 breaks the bootstrap.

### Shared infrastructure

| Infrastructure | State |
| --- | --- |
| Queue / broker | None in use. `config/queue.php` default is `database` and the `jobs`/`job_batches`/`failed_jobs` tables exist as framework defaults, but no job class, no `ShouldQueue` listener and no scheduler entry exists; `routes/console.php` holds only the stock `inspire` command. `phpunit.xml` forces `sync`. |
| Cache tier | None in use. `CACHE_STORE=database` with the `cache`/`cache_locks` tables present, but no `Cache::`/`cache()` call exists in `app/`, `routes/` or `bootstrap/`. Redis is explicitly out of v1 (`README.md`). |
| Sessions | Laravel database session driver (`SESSION_DRIVER=database`, table `sessions`) — the auth cookie the JSON API rides on. |
| Observability | Framework logging only (`LOG_STACK`, `config/logging.php`) plus `laravel/pail` for local tailing. No APM, Telescope, Pulse or Nightwatch package is installed; `phpunit.xml` merely disables those env flags. |
| Health check | `/up`, declared via `bootstrap/app.php` `health: '/up'`. |
| Static assets | Vite build output under `public/build`. A failed `npm run build` empties it and reds ~10 tests with `ViteManifestNotFoundException` (`.ai/rules/auth.md`). |
| Agent tooling | `.ai/rules/` (15 glob-scoped rule files + `index.md`), `.ai/guidelines/php-laravel.md`, `.claude/` with 7 committed skills, `.mcp.json` (Laravel Boost). `scripts/ralph.sh` is a dev-only phase orchestration driver, not app runtime. |
